spec: CONFORMANCE_SPEC.md §7 (`removed_op`); esm-spec §4.2 "Removed ops" and "The `faq` tag"; docs/content/rfcs/faq-node-rename.md
description: The two removed spellings of the Functional Aggregate Query node: `arrayop` (removed at esm 0.8.0) and `aggregate` (a deprecated alias from 1.1.0, removed at 2.0.0). Neither is normalized; both are rejected BY NAME with `removed_op`, in the root and in every referenced document.

cases.assert: loads with no diagnostic, and emit(load(x)) == x (the §9.6.4 fixed point)
REJECTED with `removed_op` — `aggregate` was removed at esm 2.0.0 and is no longer normalized
REJECTED with `removed_op` — `arrayop` was removed at esm 0.8.0
REJECTED with `removed_op` — the child's removed spelling is caught at the child's own wire boundary

note: Some bindings resolve subsystem `{ref}`s during load; TypeScript exposes it as a separate `resolveSubsystemRefs` API. A binding's adapter invokes whatever its load path requires — the CONTRACT is that once refs are resolved, no removed spelling survives anywhere in the document.
